safeShipping.title: Safe shipping guide
safeShipping.intro: Protect your card to minimize transit damage and disputes.
safeShipping.step1Body: Put the card in a protective sleeve.
safeShipping.step2Body: Slide the sleeve into a rigid top loader.
safeShipping.step3Body: Wrap the top loader and place it in a rigid mailer.
safeShipping.step4Body: Ship everything inside a padded envelope or small box.

legal.title: Terms & policy
legal.intro: These terms apply to every purchase and to card custody at TCG Vault MX.
legal.scopeNote: The policy applies to every product type: raw, sealed and graded cards.
legal.refundBody: All sales are final. Once you buy a card, the sale is not eligible for a refund or cancellation.
legal.platformErrorBody: If the problem is an error on our side —for example, a duplicate charge or a purchase with no real inventory backing it— we always refund you, with no need to open a dispute.
legal.disputeBody: Another exception is receiving a damaged or wrong card. In that case you may open a condition dispute within 7 calendar days, counted from shipment delivery. Evidence is sent by email to our support inbox (no photo upload in the app).
legal.disputeWindowNote: The 7-day window starts on the day the shipment is delivered, not on the purchase or payment date.
legal.disputeOutcome: If the dispute is upheld, we compensate you for the damage or error and you keep the card: there is no product return.
legal.questionsBody: For any clarification about these terms, email us at soporte@tcgvaultmx.com.

dispute.evidenceBody: Email your photos and evidence to our support inbox, citing your order or dispute number. No photo upload in the app.

updatePrices.title: Update prices
updatePrices.subtitle: Refresh reference prices across the whole catalog. This is the module's primary action; it runs 1–2 times a day and you can also trigger it by hand here.

advancedOps.title: Advanced catalog / sync operations
advancedOps.subtitle: Catalog maintenance and sync tools: use them only when you need to import new sets, reprocess everything, or set pending prices by hand.

sync.title: Price sync (vault)
sync.subtitle: Refresh the reference price of vault cards from the source per type. Daily cache.

pending.title: Pending-price queue
pending.subtitle: Cards without a reference price, escalated to set manually. The buyer never sees this state.

fx.title: USD→MXN exchange rate
fx.hint: MXN price = USD price × rate × (1 + buffer/100). The manual override takes priority over the day's automatic rate.
fx.bufferOnlyHint: You can save just the buffer: leave the rate empty to keep the current rate.
fx.savedBufferOnly: Buffer updated; kept the current rate.

priceIngest.title: Bulk price ingest
priceIngest.subtitle: Refreshes prices for the WHOLE catalog in batches (one job per set) from the selected provider. It's the primary pricing path; it runs 1–2 times a day and you can also trigger it manually.
priceIngest.providerHint: Change the price source without a redeploy. Rollback lever: if the paid provider fails, switch back to pokemontcg.io instantly.
priceIngest.triggerHint: Queues the bulk ingest (same as the scheduled run); processed set by set, in the background.
priceIngest.queued: Price ingest queued; processing in the background.
priceIngest.alreadyRunning: A price ingest is already running; no second run was queued.

catalog.title: Catalog sync (pokemontcg.io)
catalog.subtitle: Import sets and cards from the reference catalog. Default sets 2024+; backfill older collections in batches.
catalog.syncAllHint: "Import new sets" brings newly released sets that aren't imported yet (light operation); the system also does this automatically twice a day. "Re-sync everything (force)" reprocesses the ENTIRE catalog and repopulates prices (heavy operation).
catalog.syncHint: Import, resync and backfill run synchronously: they may take a while and the result appears when they finish. Don't leave this screen.
catalog.syncRunning: Syncing with pokemontcg.io… this may take a few seconds.
catalog.syncAllQueued: Sweep queued: {count} set(s) — importing in the background; the list updates on its own.
catalog.syncAllNothing: Nothing pending to import (the catalog is up to date).
catalog.syncAllUnavailable: Full sync isn't available on the backend; use per-set sync or backfill.
catalog.sweepRunningHint: Runs in the background; you can keep working. Progress and the list update automatically.
catalog.syncAllForceConfirmBody: This reprocesses the ENTIRE catalog, including already imported sets, to repopulate finishes and prices. It's a heavy operation that may take a while. Continue?

buylistRules.title: Buylist price by rarity
buylistRules.subtitle: Define a rule per official rarity: fixed amount (MX$) or percentage (% of reference). Rarities without a rule use the fallback. Takes effect without redeploy and is audited.
buylistRules.fallbackHint: Applies to rarities without an explicit rule (new or unconfigured).
buylistRules.example: Example: the % is what you PAY of the reference. At 40%, you pay MX$40 for a MX$100 card.

salesRules.title: Sale price rules by rarity
salesRules.subtitle: Define a sale rule per official rarity: fixed amount (MX$, acts as a floor) or percentage (% over market). Rarities without a rule use the fallback. Replaces the single global markup. Takes effect without redeploy and is audited.
salesRules.fallbackHint: Applies to rarities without an explicit rule (new or unconfigured). It is a markup above market.
salesRules.pctHint: Percentage: sale price = market × (1 + %). Example: 15% keeps the price 15% above market (up to 1000% allowed). Fixed: the MX$ amount is a sale floor.
salesRules.example: Example: the % is what you add ON TOP of market. At +15%, you sell a MX$100 card for MX$115.
